member.name: T:Memid.MemidResources
member.summary: A Win32 resource file (.res) holding MEMID data as RT_RCDATA resources named MEMID and MEMIDX, which MEMID readers look for in a PE that has no .memid / .memidx section. For binaries that can't get a section of their own, such as .NET apps: write the file before the build and reference it from the project (<Win32Resource>). It replaces the resources the SDK would generate (version, icon, manifest), so a project that needs those adds them to the same file with its own resource compiler.

member.name: T:Memid.PeSections
member.summary:
Adds, replaces and removes a read-only data section in a PE image (an EXE or DLL as bytes), for tools that patch a binary they didn't build: a .memidx describing the patch, or a .memid in a binary of one's own.
Only the last section can be replaced or removed, and a new section goes last. A tool that grows its own last section (a code cave) removes the MEMID section first, patches, then sets it again.
Refused, with : a signed image (its certificate table would no longer match), data after the last section (an overlay the new section would land behind), and a section table with no room for another header.
